title: User-facing feature catalog (shared/features/catalog.yaml)
description: One entry per user-facing feature: what problem it solves, how mature it is, which release carries it, which adapters deliver it and how, what it needs, where its guide is, and which runtime capabilities it rests on. The runtime capability registry (shared/capabilities/) owns capability semantics; this catalog references capability ids and never restates them. Rendered into docs/features.md by scripts/generate-feature-index.sh; validated by scripts/validate-features.sh, which reads the enums below rather than restating them.

maturity.description: Product maturity, defined in docs/maturity.md. 'stable': in a tagged release, covered by CI, contract not expected to change. 'beta': complete and CI-covered, run on real work, contract may still change. 'experimental': shipped to learn from use; may change or be removed. 'deprecated': still present, being retired; the entry names the replacement.

adapter_support.description: How an adapter delivers the feature. 'enforced': a runtime gate in that adapter can block. 'advisory': the adapter receives the feature as content the tool reads but cannot enforce. 'unsupported': not delivered to that adapter. 'neutral': the feature runs outside any adapter (a script or CLI) and needs nothing from it.

release.description: The first tagged release carrying the feature, or 'unreleased' when it exists only on master.

problem.description: One sentence: what the user gets, in their terms.

replaced_by.description: Required when maturity is 'deprecated': the id of the feature that replaces it.

adapters.description: Every adapter under adapters/ must be classified; the validator refuses a missing or unknown adapter id.

prerequisites.description: What must exist before the feature works: tools, keys, services, other features.

guide.description: Repo-relative path of the primary guide; must exist.

commands.description: Slash commands (adapters/claude-code/.claude/commands/<name>.md) that enter the feature; each must exist.

skills.description: Skills (shared/skills/<name>/SKILL.md) the feature rests on; each must exist.

capabilities.description: Runtime capability ids from shared/capabilities/catalog.yaml; each must resolve.
